dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

McMuffin was surrendered to the care center as a stray, and we have no history on her behavior in a home environment. During her time at the care center, McMuffin has been tolerant of handling but has shown highly fearful behavior; during her handling assessment, she was trembling and while she stayed in proximity to handlers, she remained very tense and could not be encouraged to move. Due to her level of fear, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide a period of decompression, any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
